ns2:course.label: Gov & Pol of East Europe
ns2:course.description: Examines the collapse of communism and efforts to develop capitalism and democracy. Special emphasis is given to national conflict and European integration. Prerequisite: PS 240 or PS 241, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: PS 240 or PS 241, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
